entries.12세 이상의 청소년 및 성인은 1회 1정씩, 1일 1회 복용합니다.아침: Adolescents aged 12 years and older and adults take 1 tablet at a time, 1 time a day. It is best taken in the morning, but it may also be taken before bedtime. It may be taken with a small amount of water.
entries.15세 미만 소아는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에 이: Children under 15 years of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with allergic symptoms to this medicine (rash, redness (congestion and reddening), itching, etc.), those who have experienced allergic symptoms to cosmetics or eggs (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), and people with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.16세 이상은 1회 1정(10 mg), 1일 2정(20 mg)까지 복용할: Those aged 16 years and older may take 1 tablet (10 mg) at a time, up to 2 tablets (20 mg) a day.
Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (diseased area) 1 time a day.
Apply an appropriate amount to the diseased area 1 to several times (multiple times) a day.
entries.1일 2~4회, 1회 2~3방울 점안합니다.점안 후 남은액과 용기는 버립: Instill 1 dose of 2 to 3 drops, 2 to 4 times a day. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
Spray and apply an appropriate amount several times in 1 day.
Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area several times in 1 day.
Spray an appropriate amount onto the affected area (diseased area) several times (multiple times) in 1 day.
entries.1회 1~2방울씩, 1일 4~5회 점안합니다.점안 후 남은액과 용기는 버: Instill 1 to 2 drops at a time, 4 to 5 times a day. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.1회 2~3방울씩, 1일 2~4회 점안합니다.점안 후 남은액과 용기는 버: Instill 1 dose of 2 to 3 drops, 2 to 4 times a day. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.1회 약 1 cm (0.2~0.5 g)의 양을 청결한 손가락이나 칫솔에: Put about 1 cm (0.2 to 0.5 g) per dose on a clean finger or a toothbrush, apply it to the gums or the affected area several times in 1 day, and then massage.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아, 눈 주위, 점막 등, 습진, 옻 등에 의한 피부염: Do not use this medicine on infants aged 30 months or younger, around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like, or on wounds. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to cosmetics, those with an allergic constitution, patients with severe wetness (dampness) or erosion (rawness), patients under a doctor's treatment, children, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, and nursing mothers should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 applications, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. Shake well before use and spray from a distance of 20 cm from the affected area (diseased area); do not spray continuously on the same area for 3 seconds or longer. Do not use it indoors where a fire is in use, and always ventilate the room after using it in a closed space.
entries.6개월~만 1세는 1일 1포(4 g), 만 1~4세는 1일 1~2포(4~: Children from 6 months to 1 year of age take 1 packet (4 g) a day, children 1 to 4 years of age take 1 to 2 packets (4 to 8 g) a day, and children 4 to 8 years of age take 2 to 4 packets (8 to 16 g) a day. Dissolve each packet in 50 mL of water before taking it. If 1 packet a day is taken, take it in the morning; if more than 1 packet a day is taken, divide the dose between morning and evening. The effect of this medicine appears within 1 to 2 days (24 to 48 hours) after it is taken.
entries.MAO 억제제(항우울제, 항정신병제, 감정조절제, 항파킨슨제 등), 다른: Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.), other antitussives and expectorants (cough and phlegm medicines), cold medicines, oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis [nasal inflammation], motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines), or sedatives.
entries.MAO 억제제(항우울제, 항정신병제, 감정조절제, 항파킨슨제 등), 진해: Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.), antitussives and expectorants (cough and phlegm medicines), other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis [nasal inflammation], motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). People who are receiving other drugs such as barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol, diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.MAO억제제(항우울제, 항정신병제, 감정조절제, 항파킨슨제 등), 다른: Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.), other antitussives and expectorants, cold medicines, oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines), or sedatives. People who are within 2 weeks of stopping MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) must not take this medicine. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol, or flucloxacillin.
entries.dl-메틸에페드린염산염, 스코폴리아엑스 및 글리시리진산 함유 좌제 또는: Do not use this medicine together with suppositories, ointments, or creams containing dl-methylephedrine hydrochloride, scopolia extract, or glycyrrhizic acid, or with antihypertensive drugs or antidepressants
entries.가려움이나 기관지 수축, 아나필락시스 반응과 같은 알레르기 반응이 나타나: If allergic reactions such as itching, bronchoconstriction, or an anaphylactic reaction occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.갈락토오스 불내성, Lapp 유당분해효소 결핍증 또는 포도당-갈락토오스: Patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 203 or those who have experienced it, and infants under 3 months of age, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 1 month of use, stop taking it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.고칼슘혈증 (혈액중에 칼슘이 과잉으로 존재하는 상태), 유육종증(원인을: Patients with hypercalcemia (a condition in which calcium is present in excess in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, or hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 12 months of age, patients with hemochromatosis (a disease in which iron is deposited in the liver and pancreas because of abnormal iron metabolism), hemosiderosis, non-iron-deficiency anemia, kidney stones, or severe renal failure, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age, children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet, patients with hyperoxaluria (a condition in which an excessive amount of oxalate is excreted in the urine), pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, premature infants, infants, patients with gastrointestinal diseases such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or localized [appearing in a specific area] colitis, and those with cardiac and circulatory dysfunction, kidney [renal] disorder, hypoproteinemia, gout, or a history of kidney stones should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical laboratory test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.과민반응이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십: If a hypersensitivity reaction occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구강에 구강마비감, 자상감, 작열감 또는 과민증, 트림, 구역, 구토,: If numbness of the mouth, a stinging sensation, a burning sensation or hypersensitivity in the oral cavity, belching, nausea, vomiting, sleep disturbance, visual hallucinations (flickering, hallucinations of color), urticaria, rash, or photosensitivity occurs, stop taking (using) this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 묽은 변, 인두염 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고: If nausea, vomiting, loose stools, or pharyngitis occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 설사의 등의 증상이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중단하고 의: If symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.국소적으로만 사용하고, 치료 부위를 면봉 등을 이용해서 해당 부위에 충분: Use it topically only; apply it thoroughly to the treatment area with a cotton swab or the like and wait for at least 1 to 2 minutes. Use it only for a short period, with a treatment period of up to 14 days at most.
entries.국소적인 피부자극감(예: 발진(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움, 건조, 작열감: If local skin irritation (e.g., rash (congestion and reddening), itching, dryness, a burning sensation (hot feeling), a stinging sensation (prickling), or swelling) occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If no improvement in symptoms appears, stop using it and consult a pharmacist or doctor.
entries.급성 복부질환(충수염, 장출혈, 궤양성 결장염 등), 장폐색(창자막힘): Patients with acute abdominal disease (appendicitis, intestinal bleeding, ulcerative colitis, etc.) or intestinal obstruction (blocked bowel) must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with severe abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, and those with kidney disorder or a history of rectal bleeding or bowel failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 week, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.급성전신발진농포증, 중증 피부이상반응(발열, 홍반, 다수의 작은 농포),: If acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, severe skin adverse reactions (fever, erythema, numerous small pustules), high fever, sedation, drowsiness, central nervous depression, central stimulation, anxiety, sweating (perspiration), mild (slight) lowering of blood pressure, visual disturbance, mydriasis (dilated pupils), delirious speech, hallucinations, agitation, muscle cramps, rigidity (stiffness), athetosis, clonic and tonic convulsions, high fever, respiratory paralysis, coma, circulatory paralysis, skin reactions, temporary irritating pain, a burning sensation (hot feeling), thirst, nausea, vomiting, difficulty urinating (passing urine), excitement, ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding), or symptoms of reversible posterior encephalopathy syndrome and reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (sudden severe headache, thunderclap headache, nausea, vomiting, confusion, seizures, visual disturbance) occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.눈 또는 눈 주위, 점막 및 습진, 상처부위, 민감한 피부에는 사용하지: Do not use it on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on wounds, or on sensitive skin. Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms such as rash and redness or itching caused by medicines or cosmetics, or dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, those with an allergic constitution, and people with severe dampness, rawness, or inflammation should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only externally, that is, as a medicine applied to the diseased area; do not take it by mouth or inhale it. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If it does get in, rinse with water. If symptoms are severe, get treatment from an ophthalmologist. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.눈의 충혈, 가려움, 부종(부기), 하드콘택트렌즈를 착용하는 사람에게서: If redness of the eye, itching, or swelling (puffiness) occurs, if a person wearing hard contact lenses has a large amount of discharge such as eye mucus with rare clouding of the lens, or if blurred vision does not improve, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제 및 나프록센 유도체, 아스피린, 고용량의: Do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, naproxen derivatives, aspirin, or high-dose methotrexate. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (NSAIDs), ACE inhibitors, lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (warfarin, etc.), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
entries.다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, 아스피린, 고용량의 메토트렉세이트와 함께: Do not use this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, aspirin, or high-dose methotrexate. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with glucocorticoids, alcohol, digoxin, phenytoin, probenecid, sulfinpyrazone, sulfonylureas, the combined use of diuretics and antihypertensives, ACE inhibitors, furosemide, lithium, low-dose methotrexate, or coumarin anticoagulants (warfarin, etc.).
entries.다른 소염(항염)진통제와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에: Do not take this medicine together with other anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, patients who take warfarin long-term or who have taken lithium or thiazide diuretics should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.다른 진토제, 감기약, 해열진통제, 항히스타민제, 진정제, 진해(기침을: Do not take this medicine together with other antiemetics, cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, antihistamines, sedatives, antitussives (which stop coughing) and expectorants (phlegm medicines), or gastrointestinal analgesic and antispasmodic (cramp-relieving) agents. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.다른 진해(기침을 그치게 함)거담제, 감기약, 항히스타민제를 함유하는 내: Do not take this medicine together with other antitussives (which stop coughing) and expectorants, cold medicines, oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines), or sedatives. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.다음의 1회 용량씩, 1일 3회 식후 30분에 복용합니다.만 15세 이상: Take the following amount as 1 dose, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. Those aged 15 years and older take 1 packet (20 ml), those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 packet, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1/2 packet, those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 1/3 packet, and those aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1/4 packet.
entries.드물게 과민반응(발진, 입술, 혀, 목 또는 얼굴의 부종, 호흡 곤란): If hypersensitivity reactions (rash, swelling of the lips, tongue, throat, or face, difficulty breathing) rarely occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Temporary peeling changes of the mucous membrane, such as a specific lesion of the oral mucosa, reduced taste, and a reversible numb state of the tongue may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, a stifling feeling, difficulty breathing, seizures) rarely occur, or if hypersensitivity symptoms (occasionally rash and redness, urticaria, itching, swelling) or anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(흉부불쾌감, 오한, 호흡곤란, 혈압저하 등), 드물게 재생불량: If the following occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist: rarely shock (chest discomfort, chills, difficulty breathing, lowered blood pressure, etc.); rarely blood disorders such as aplastic anemia, hemolytic anemia, granulocytopenia, leukopenia, agranulocytosis, pancytopenia, thrombocytopenia, decreased platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), and eosinophilia; indigestion, abdominal distension, heartburn, upper abdominal pain, diarrhea or constipation; occasionally loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or stomach discomfort; rarely esophagitis, esophageal stricture, worsening of diverticula, nonspecific hemorrhagic colitis, ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, peptic ulcer, gastrointestinal bleeding, perforation, bloody stools, gastritis, or pancreatitis; very rarely thirst, stomatitis, erythema multiforme, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), or hair loss; occasionally angioedema; rarely Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome); drug rash with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS syndrome) of unknown frequency; occasionally rash, urticaria, itching, or purpura; rarely induction of an asthma attack, eczema, anaphylactic reactions, or photosensitivity reactions; rarely jaundice, elevated ALT, elevated AST, elevated ALP, abnormal liver function, hepatitis, or jaundice; occasionally rhinitis, bronchospasm, or acute pneumonia; rarely visual disturbances such as impaired vision and dark spots, hearing loss, tinnitus, or taste abnormality; fatigue, drowsiness, headache, or dizziness; occasionally anxiety, restlessness, confusion, or depression; rarely aseptic meningitis, severe headache, nausea, vomiting, insomnia, stiff neck, fever, or impaired consciousness; rarely mental abnormality, agitation, excitement, disorientation, or reversible toxic amblyopia; rarely lowered blood pressure, raised blood pressure, palpitations, oliguria, hematuria, proteinuria, elevated BUN and blood creatinine, hyperkalemia, decreased urine volume, generalized edema and the accompanying shortness of breath, or languor; rarely renal papillary necrosis, nephrotic syndrome, interstitial nephritis, peripheral edema, acute pulmonary edema, fluid retention, hypertension, heart failure, or reduced fertility in women; occasionally periorbital edema; very rarely malaise, fever, nosebleed, or worsening of inflammation.
entries.드물게 피부염, 접촉과민, 광과민, 아나필락시스반응 등이 나타날 수 있습: Rarely, dermatitis, contact hypersensitivity, photosensitivity, and anaphylactic reactions may occur.
entries.때때로 일과성(한번 나타나고 없어지는)의 위통, 두통, 가슴쓰림, 위부팽: Occasionally, transient (appearing once and then disappearing) stomach pain, headache, heartburn, a feeling of fullness in the stomach, loss of appetite, and nausea (queasiness) may occur.
Do not take this medicine together with medicines containing levodopa.
entries.류마티양 관절염, 골관절염, 강직성 척추염, 연조직손상, 비관절 류마티스: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic disease, acute gout, and psoriatic arthritis, adults take 200-600 mg at a time, 3-4 times a day. Up to a maximum of 3,200 mg a day may be administered. For juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, take 30-40 mg per kg of body weight at a time, 3 to 4 times a day. For mild to moderate pain and colds, adults take 200-400 mg at a time, 3 to 4 times a day. The dose may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. Children 11 to 14 years of age take 200 to 250 mg (10 to 12.5 mL) at a time, children 7 to 10 years of age take 150 to 200 mg (7.5 to 10 mL) at a time, children 3 to 6 years of age take 100 to 150 mg (5 to 7.5 mL) at a time, and children 1 to 2 years of age take 50 to 100 mg (2.5 to 5 mL) at a time, 3 to 4 times a day.

Up to a maximum of 3200 mg a day may be taken. For juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, take 30-40 mg per kg of body weight a day, divided into 3-4 doses. For mild to moderate pain and colds, take 200-400 mg at a time, 3-4 times a day. Children take the following single dose 3-4 times a day; for children weighing less than 30 kg the daily amount must not exceed 500 mg (25 ml), and it is preferable not to take it on an empty stomach. Increase or decrease the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.만 12세 이상 및 성인은 1회 20 mL씩, 1일 2회 복용합니다.필요: Those aged 12 years and older and adults take 1 dose of 20 mL, 2 times a day. If necessary, dilute it in a little water before taking it.
Adolescents aged 12 years and older and adults take 1 tablet at a time, 1 time a day.
entries.만 12세 이하의 소아는 다음 1회 권장용량을 4~6시간 마다 필요 시: Children aged 12 years and under take the following recommended 1-time dose every 4 to 6 hours as needed. For the recommended 1-time dose by age group, refer to the approved labeling. Take the lowest effective dose for the shortest possible period, and do not take it more than 5 times a day (75 mg/kg). If the body weight is known, it is more appropriate to take a dose based on body weight (10 to 15 mg/kg).
entries.만 15세 이상 1회 1포(20 mL), 만 11세 이상∼만 15세 미만: Those aged 15 years and older take 1 packet (20 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 packet at a time, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1/2 packet at a time, those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 1/3 packet at a time, and those aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1/4 packet at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. As a rule, keep the interval between doses at 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1병씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만: Those aged 15 years and older and adults take 1 bottle at a time, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 bottle, those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 1/2 bottle, those aged 5 years to under 8 years take 1/3 bottle, those aged 3 years to under 5 years take 1/4 bottle, and those aged 1 year to under 3 years take 1/5 bottle, 3 times a day after meals. Keep the interval between doses at 4 hours or more.
entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1포(3 g)씩, 1일 3회 식후 30분: Those aged 15 years and older and adults take 1 packet (3 g) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 2캡슐을 1일 3회 식후 30분에 4시간: Those aged 15 years and older and adults take 1 dose of 2 capsules, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals, at 4-hour intervals.

entries.이 약은 상처를 청결히 한 후 환부에 1일 1~수회 바릅니다.수유기 중의: After cleaning the wound, apply this medicine to the affected area 1 to several times a day. For cracked nipples during breastfeeding, apply it to the nipple right after each feeding.
This medicine is used to treat the symptoms of constipation in children.
entries.이 약은 수술자의 손 및 팔의 살균소독, 손의 살균소독, 수술부위의 살균: This medicine is used for disinfection of the surgeon's hands and arms, disinfection of the hands, and disinfection of the surgical site.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 피부염, 가려움, 벌레물린: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, heat rash, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, itching, insect bites, urticaria, and chilblains.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 미란(짓무름), 땀띠, 접촉성피부염, 가려움,: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, erosion (rawness), heat rash, contact dermatitis, itching, frostbite (frozen injury), insect bites, and urticaria.
entries.이 약은 안구건조증 또는 바람·태양에 의한 화끈거리는 증상, 자극감, 불: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of a burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by dry eye syndrome or by wind and sun, and for the prevention of eye irritation.
This medicine is used for acne and pimples.
entries.이 약은 영양부족으로 인한 각막 및 결막의 궤양성 질환에 영양공급, 콘택: This medicine is used to supply nutrition for ulcerative diseases of the cornea and conjunctiva caused by malnutrition, and for microscopic damage to the cornea and conjunctiva caused by wearing contact lenses and the like.
entries.이 약은 위ㆍ십이지장궤양, 위염, 위산과다, 속쓰림, 구역, 구토, 위통: This medicine is used for its antacid action and for the improvement of symptoms in gastric and duodenal ulcer, gastritis, excess stomach acid, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and acid belching.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 · 수유기, 병중 · 병후(병을 앓는 동안이나: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), to relieve the symptoms of neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), and for beriberi and eye fatigue.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery).
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후의 체력 저하 시 B2, B6: This medicine is used to supply B2 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced physical strength during or after illness, to relieve the symptoms of angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation of the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
entries.이 약은 인후(목구멍)통, 기침, 가래, 오한(춥고 떨리는 증상), 발열: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 자양강장, 허약체질, 육체피로, 병후의 체력저하, 식욕부진, 영: This medicine is used as a nutritional tonic and for a weak constitution, physical fatigue, reduced physical strength after illness, loss of appetite, nutritional disorders, and febrile and wasting diseases.
entries.이 약은 전립선비대에 의한 배뇨(소변을 눔)곤란 · 잔뇨 및 잔뇨감 ·: This medicine is used for difficulty urinating (passing urine), residual urine and the feeling of residual urine, and frequent urination caused by an enlarged prostate.
This medicine is used to disinfect wound areas on a small area of the skin.
entries.이 약은 치열·치핵의 아픔·가려움·부종(부기)·출혈의 일시적인 완화에 사: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain, itching, swelling (puffiness), and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치은염, 구내염, 혀염, 입술염, 사랑니주위염 및 치조 농루의: This medicine is used to relieve gingivitis, stomatitis, glossitis, cheilitis, pericoronitis around a wisdom tooth, and alveolar pyorrhea.
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염), 알레르기성 비염 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘: This medicine is used to relieve stuffy nose, runny nose, sneezing, watery eyes, sore throat, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a nasal cold (acute rhinitis), allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농(곪음)성으로 인한 코막힘에 비강(코안): This medicine is used for washing the nasal cavity (the inside of the nose) for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucosal discharge or suppuration (festering), and to relieve dryness of the nasal mucosa.
entries.이 약은 피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포 및 함소, 분무 흡입제로서: This medicine is used for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses and gargling, as a spray inhalant for cleansing the mucous membranes and promoting the expulsion of sputum, and for cleaning medical instruments.
This medicine is used for contraception.
entries.이 약은 효모균에 의한 다음의 피부질환(비듬, 지루피부염, 어루러기)에: This medicine is used for the following skin diseases caused by yeast fungi (dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis, tinea versicolor).
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 이 약을 사용하기 전에 최: When this medicine is used at the same time as other eye drops, leave an interval of at least 15 minutes before using this medicine.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 약에 과민증 환자, 알레르기 체질, 간장애, 신장: Before taking this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to medicines, those with an allergic constitution, patients with liver disorder, kidney disorder, thyroid disease, diabetes, high fever, high blood pressure, heart disorder, or edema, frail people, elderly people, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, and children under 2 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 아세트아미노펜을 포함하는 다른 제품, MAO억제제: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with other products containing acetaminophen, MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.), antitussives and expectorants, other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). People who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of stopping them must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people who are receiving diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, and the like should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide). Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with antitussives and expectorants, other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, antihistamines, or preparations containing diphenhydramine. Before taking this medicine, people who are receiving diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol, flucloxacillin, barbiturates, or tricyclic antidepressants should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테오필린, 리토나비어와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.이: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with theophylline or ritonavir. While taking this medicine, do not take it together with a large amount of alcohol.
While taking this medicine, do not take antipsychotics or sleeping pills together with it.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 약이나 화장품에 등에 의한 알레르기 증상이 나타난: Before using this medicine, patients who have had allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, patients with an extensive affected area, and patients with severe wounds or severe burns should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after several days of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it by mouth.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 이 약에 과민증 환자, 알레르기 체질인 환자, 눈: Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to it, patients with an allergic constitution, patients with severe eye pain, and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use this medicine for instillation in the eye only. Do not share it with other people. Do not use a product whose expiry date has passed, and even within the expiry date, use it promptly after opening.
entries.이 약을 사용하는 동안 dl-메틸에페드린염산염, 스코폴리아 엑스 및 글리: While using this medicine, do not use suppositories, ointments, or creams containing dl-methylephedrine hydrochloride, scopolia extract, or glycyrrhizic acid. While using this medicine, do not take antihypertensive drugs or antidepressants.
Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with diuretics.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구(먹는)용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파: Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral (taken by mouth) tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with oral (taken by mouth) contraceptives containing estrogen, antialdosterone agents, triamterene, or cardiac glycosides. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수유부, 갈락토오스 불내: Pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, elderly people, patients with high blood pressure, heart disorder or kidney disorder, edema, or a weak stomach and intestines, patients with symptoms of diarrhea, loose stools, loss of appetite, nausea, or vomiting, patients in a weakened state after illness or whose physical strength is markedly weakened, patients who sweat a great deal, patients with circulatory disorders such as angina or myocardial infarction, urination disorders, hyperthyroidism, or diabetes, and those who have experienced allergic symptoms (rash, redness, itching, etc.) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take it continuously for 1 week or longer. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month (about 1 week when it is taken for constipation), stop taking it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.전염성 농가진, 모낭염, 바이러스성 감염증, 부스럼, 피부자극, 자통,: If impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, viral infection, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, itching, rash, redness, flushing, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, heat rash, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis, hypersensitivity, skin discoloration, hypertrichosis, acneiform eruption, hypopigmentation, perioral dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, skin maceration, 2nd (secondary) infection, skin atrophy, striae, or, when it is used on the eyelid skin, increased intraocular pressure or glaucoma (blurred vision, impaired vision) occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Because of systemic absorption, reversible suppression of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, Cushing's syndrome, hyperglycemia, diabetes, and impaired vision may occur.
entries.정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키십시오.어린이에게 투여할 경우 보호자의 지도: Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for instillation in the eye only. After it has been opened, use this medicine only 1 time. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as much as possible. If no improvement in symptoms is seen after about 2 weeks of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take this medicine within 1 hour after taking an antacid or drinking milk.
Do not use it for injection.
entries.중증 또는 조절되지 않는 고혈압 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약: Patients with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, children and people with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, glaucoma, or a breathing disorder such as asthma or chronic bronchitis should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms do not improve within 7 days, or if a fever develops, stop taking it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제, 항히스타민제를 함유하는: Do not take this medicine together with antitussives and expectorants, other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol, or flucloxacillin. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.질환 부위가 곪아 있는 사람, 심질환, 고혈압, 갑상선질환, 당뇨병, 전: People whose diseased area is festering, patients with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating caused by an enlarged prostate, and nursing mothers must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If no improvement in symptoms appears after about 7 days of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only on the anal area. Do not use it in the eyes. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.칼륨함유제제, 감초함유제제, 글리시리진산 혹은 그 염류 함유제제, 루프계: People who are taking potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide) should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.테오필린, 리토나비어와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.과량의 알코올과 함께 복용: Do not take this medicine together with theophylline or ritonavir. Do not take it together with a large amount of alcohol. If it is taken together with alcohol or other central nervous system (CNS) depressants, alertness may be further reduced and impaired performance may occur, so consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.테트라사이클린계 항생물질을 함께 복용하지 마십시오.이 약의 흡착작용 또는: Do not take tetracycline antibiotics together with this medicine. Because of the adsorptive action of this medicine or the rise in pH in the digestive tract and body fluids, it may affect the absorption and excretion of medicines taken together with it.
entries.통증, 열감, 때때로 홍조, 가려움 등이 나타날 수 있습니다.과민증상,: Pain, a sensation of heat, and occasionally flushing and itching may occur. If hypersensitivity symptoms, occasionally eczematization, cracking (splitting) of the skin, papules, a prickling sensation, a burning sensation, or scaling, or rarely swelling or dryness occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.트림, 경련성 복부불쾌감, 설사, 때때로 복명, 복부팽만감, 복통, 식욕: If belching, cramping abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, or occasionally borborygmus, a feeling of abdominal fullness, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, or vomiting occurs, or
Patients who have been given probenecid should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포, 함소, 분무흡입, 의료용 기구의 세: Use an appropriate amount for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses, gargling, and spray inhalation, and for cleaning medical instruments.
entries.피부의 세균성(전염성 농가진, 모낭염 등), 바이러스성 감염증, 모낭염,: If bacterial skin infections (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.), viral infections, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, itching, rash and redness, flushing, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, heat rash, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis, hypersensitivity, skin discoloration, hypertrichosis, acneiform eruption, hypopigmentation, perioral dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, skin maceration, 2nd (secondary) infection, skin atrophy, or striae occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울, 1일 수회 점안하십시오.아래 눈꺼풀을: As needed, instill 1 drop into each eye at a time, several times a day. Gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking up, instill one drop into the lower conjunctival sac.
entries.필요시 2~3시간마다 성인은 1~8회, 영아는 1회, 1개월~12개월은: As needed, every 2 to 3 hours, adults spray 1 to 8 times, newborn infants 1 time, babies 1 month to 12 months 1 to 2 times, children 1 to 2 years 1 to 3 times, children 2 to 5 years 1 to 4 times, children 5 to 8 years 1 to 5 times, and children 8 to 12 years 1 to 6 times. Use it while lying on your side at an angle or standing with the head tilted, so that the solution does not run down into the larynx or pharynx.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안합니다.점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.항히스타민제, 항세로토닌, 근이완제(파파베린)와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with antihistamines, antiserotonin agents, or muscle relaxants (papaverine).
entries.환부를 깨끗이 씻어 내고 1일 2회씩, 아침, 저녁으로 환부에 충분한 양: Wash the affected area clean and apply a sufficient amount to the affected area 2 times in 1 day, in the morning and in the evening.
entries.흔하게 건조감, 피부 벗겨짐, 때때로 일시적인 작열감, 저림, 드물게 홍: If commonly a feeling of dryness or peeling of the skin, occasionally a temporary burning sensation or numbness, rarely erythema, pigmentation, inflammation, bacterial (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.) or fungal (candidiasis, tinea, etc.) skin infections, general skin symptoms (folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, miliaria, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis), or, when it is used on the eyelid skin, increased intraocular pressure or glaucoma, or blurred vision of unknown frequency occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
